turns.tutor:
Hello! Yes, we can practise this. Talking about what happened at work is very useful.

Quick question first: how do you usually ask someone about something that finished yesterday?

Our goal today: ask and answer questions about finished actions in the past, using did.

Here is a model from a work setting (my own example): "Did you finish the report yesterday?"

Your task: imagine a colleague was away on a business trip last week. Write two questions with did to ask about it. Then we will look at your questions together.
